text: [whispers] Fifty gaming legends. [excited] Only a true gamer gets them all.
[excited] Round one. Warm-up! Who is this star?
[excited] Mario! He started out as Jumpman.
[excited] Easy one. Name this hero.
[excited] Pikachu! Its name is a spark plus a squeak.
[excited] Think you know this icon?
[excited] Pac-Man! Legend says he's a pizza missing a slice.
[curious] Quick! Name that shadow.
[excited] Sonic! Sega's answer to Mario.
[excited] Number five. Guess the character.
[excited] Bowser! In Japan, he's called Koopa.
[excited] You know this one. Say it!
[excited] Yoshi! He debuted in Super Mario World.
[curious] Who's lurking in the shadow?
[excited] Luigi! He began life as Mario in green.
[excited] Big shadow. Can you guess it?
[excited] Donkey Kong! Mario's very first enemy.
[excited] Blocky shape. What's the name?
[excited] Steve! Minecraft is the best-selling game ever.
[curious] Number ten. Do you know them?
[excited] Kirby! Born as a placeholder blob called Popopo.
[excited] Bonus! Decode the emojis.
[excited] Angry Birds! Rovio's fifty-second game. [laughs] Fifty-one came first.
[excited] Which hero is this?
[excited] Crash Bandicoot! Naughty Dog's PlayStation mascot.
[excited] Last easy one. Name it fast!
[excited] Mega Man! He steals boss powers.
[excited] Level one cleared. Medium mode.
[mischievously] Medium mode begins. Name this one.
[excited] Link! Not Zelda. Everyone mixes that up.
[curious] Getting trickier. Can you guess?
[excited] Master Chief! His Spartan number is one-seventeen.
[curious] Who's hiding here?
[excited] Lara Croft! Gaming's first big action heroine.
[mischievously] Fight night. Name this brawler.
[excited] Sub-Zero! Mortal Kombat's ice ninja.
[curious] Another fighter. Know the name?
[excited] Scorpion! "Get over here!" started with him.
[curious] Which fighter is this?
[excited] Chun-Li! Street Fighter's first playable woman.
[mischievously] Final fighter. Take your best shot.
[excited] Ryu! The original Street Fighter hero.
[curious] Number twenty. Name that character.
[excited] Spyro! A purple dragon from nineteen ninety-eight.
[curious] Bonus! Which came first?
[excited] Pac-Man! Nineteen eighty. A year before Donkey Kong.
[curious] Weird shape. Name it.
[excited] Rayman! No arms. No legs. No problem.
[mischievously] Royalty alert. Name this ruler.
[excited] Princess Peach! Once called Princess Toadstool.
[curious] Old-school cartoon. Recognize it?
[excited] Cuphead! Hand-drawn like nineteen-thirties cartoons.
[curious] Don't blink. What is this?
[laughs] Creeper! Born from a coding mistake.
[mischievously] Last medium one. Any guesses?
[laughs] Wario! His name means bad Mario.
[excited] Level two cleared. Score in comments. [mischievously] Hard mode.
[serious] Hard mode. Name this monster.
[excited] Charizard! He's not even a Dragon type.
[serious] Take a guess.
[excited] Fox McCloud! Star Fox's ace pilot.
[mischievously] Name this soldier.
[excited] Cloud Strife! Final Fantasy Seven's spiky-haired soldier.
[serious] Rage incoming. Name this warrior.
[excited] Kratos! He went from Greek gods to Norse.
[serious] Suit up. Name this hero.
[gasps] Samus Aran! Metroid's big twist: she's a woman.
[curious] Bonus! Name this console.
[excited] Nintendo 64! Three handles, one analog stick.
[mischievously] Sneak up. Name this spy.
[mischievously] Solid Snake! A cardboard box. Still works.
[serious] Demons beware. Name this slayer.
[excited] Doom Slayer! Doom came out in nineteen ninety-three.
[serious] Short shadow. Can you name him?
[excited] Sans! Undertale was made mostly by one person.
[mischievously] Name this wanderer.
[excited] Geralt of Rivia! Born in Polish fantasy novels.
[serious] Yeehaw! Name this outlaw.
[excited] Arthur Morgan! Voiced by Roger Clark.
[serious] Think fast. Name this scientist.
[mischievously] Gordon Freeman! He never speaks. Not once.
[mischievously] Treasure time. Name this explorer.
[excited] Nathan Drake! Claims he descends from Sir Francis Drake.
[serious] One name. Which villain is this?
[excited] Sephiroth! His theme is One-Winged Angel.
[gasps] Warning! [serious] Expert mode. Most people fail here.
[whispers] Cute but tricky.
[excited] Sackboy! A knitted burlap doll.
[serious] Chaos incoming. Name this madman.
[excited] Trevor Philips! Voiced by Steven Ogg.
[mischievously] Myth or fact?
[excited] Fact! Sony and Nintendo built it. [sighs] Then Nintendo quit.
[whispers] Who's in the hood?
[excited] Ezio Auditore! Star of three Assassin's Creed games.
[whispers] Psychic shadow. Name it.
[gasps] Mewtwo! A clone of Mew.
[serious] Retro vibes. Name this mascot.
[excited] Vault Boy! Fallout's thumbs-up mascot.
[whispers] Spooky shadow. Name this ghost.
[mischievously] Gengar! Pokédex number ninety-four.
[whispers] Sneaky one. Name this thief.
[excited] Sly Cooper! A raccoon thief on PlayStation Two.
[excited] Bonus! Konami Code time.
[excited] The Konami Code! Thirty lives in Contra.
[serious] Tough one. Name this survivor.
[excited] Joel Miller! Voiced by Troy Baker.
[whispers] Now her. Can you name her?
[excited] Ellie! Voiced by Ashley Johnson.
[whispers] Expert only. Name this warrior.
[gasps] Hornet! Fans begged for her own game. Silksong delivered.
[serious] Silent hero. Which one is this?
[excited] The Knight! Hollow Knight's silent hero.
[serious] Final round. Name the last shadow.
[gasps] Ghost! Call of Duty's masked operator. [excited] Simon Riley, skull mask and all.
[mischievously] Did you guess number fifty? [excited] Subscribe for more!
